thermal-inertia.processing: As served by author-listed numeric WMS; 0–360° grid rolled to −180–180°. Negative mineral sentinels become NoData. Thermal-inertia delivery sampled at 2 pixels/degree; other arrays retain the requested native sampling. Spectral fractions are unmixing estimates, not extractable ore grades. Values have not been sharpened or filled.

ice-0_1.processing: Original signed composite ice consistency, not probability or reserves. Sensing-depth band 0–1 m (>5 m for 5). NoData −30 remains transparent. Source projected grid maps to ±180° and ±60° within 0.001°; geographic bounds normalized to those published limits. No gap filling.

ice-1_5.processing: Original signed composite ice consistency, not probability or reserves. Sensing-depth band 1–5 m (>5 m for 5). NoData −30 remains transparent. Source projected grid maps to ±180° and ±60° within 0.001°; geographic bounds normalized to those published limits. No gap filling.

ice-5.processing: Original signed composite ice consistency, not probability or reserves. Sensing-depth band 5 m (>5 m for 5). NoData −30 remains transparent. Source projected grid maps to ±180° and ±60° within 0.001°; geographic bounds normalized to those published limits. No gap filling.

sources.title: NASA PDS Odyssey GRS K 5° unsmoothed · v2.0

potassium-abundance.processing: 2002-06-04 to 2005-04-03 observations; invalid 9999.999 bins transparent. Negative peak-fit estimates retained, not interpreted as physically negative abundance. Thorium converted from weight percent to ppm by ×10,000. 5° bins are not instrument resolving power. Water equivalent does not establish extractable ice. See separate sigma asset for published statistical errors; correction-factor errors are not added.

sources.title: ASU JMARS · Mars Odyssey Neutron Spectrometer % WEH · Wilson et al. (2017)

mons-weh.processing: ASU published numeric MONS reconstruction, ingested by ASU 2019-02-22; global 720×360 array including both polar regions. Source DOUB/RIEEE converted to float32 only. No SWIM merging, gap filling, saturation replacement or scientific smoothing. Values near 100 are model-limited hydrogen estimates, not confirmed pure or accessible water ice. Service registration cross-checked with MOLA Olympus Mons at 133.5°W, 17.5°N. Grid spacing is finer than the ~290 km effective resolving power in Wilson et al. (2017).

display.title: Global near-surface hydrogen · MONS
display.note: Both polar regions covered · wt% H₂O equivalent, not ice probability · ~290 km effective resolution. High values may reach the model limit; no reserves claim.

rock-abundance.native_sampling: TES 8 pixels/degree (~7.5 km); delivery 4 pixels/degree (~15 km)
rock-abundance.processing: Published TES thermal-model rock abundance. Source NullValue 0 is masked exactly; it is not interpreted as zero rocks. Nonzero integer percentages retain their original values. EPSG:4326 signed-east request is already north-up; no longitude rolling or gap filling.

display.title: Rock abundance · TES reference
display.note: % rock from orbital thermal modeling · ≈15 km delivery · no individual-boulder or route-safety claim

surface-dust-cover-index-reference-compo.native_sampling: TES 16 pixels/degree (~3.5 km); delivery 4 pixels/degree (~15 km)
surface-dust-cover-index-reference-compo.processing: Published Ruff and Christensen (2002) dimensionless DCI. Mask only the exact float32 source sentinel 0.85000002; retain other finite source values, including outliers. No conversion to dust thickness, airborne opacity or current conditions.

display.title: Surface dust cover · TES reference
display.note: Lower index: finer / dustier surface · higher: less fine dust · static reference; not atmospheric dust. Values outside the display ramp remain in the source-cell readout.

gravity-anomalies.processing: ASU-served JGMRO_120D_ANOM_095. Difference of model gravity on the geoid from normal gravity on the publisher reference ellipsoid (a=3397 km, GM=42828.37582 km³/s², f=0.005079304192, rotation=7.088218081e-5 rad/s). Preserve signed mGal; 1 mGal = 1e-5 m/s². Not Bouguer anomaly or total surface acceleration.

display.title: Gravity anomaly · JPL MRO120D
display.note: Signed mGal relative to the model reference ellipsoid · degrees 2–95 · not local g or a buried-resource measurement

sources.title: Atlas sourced target catalogue · per-record primary citations

catalogue-density-100km.native_sampling: 1° evaluation grid (~59 km); fixed spherical-cap count
catalogue-density-100km.processing: Count each of 2494 unique catalogue IDs once when its published representative coordinate is within 100 km. Spherical Mars radius 3396190.0 m; cap area 31413.657 km². Multiple records can describe the same locality; records are not equal-sized deposits. Zero means no catalogue records in this window, not absence of scientific interest. Global catalogue completeness is not established.

display.title: Catalogue target density · 100 km radius
display.note: Counts catalogue records only · uneven research coverage · zero does not mean no science or resources

sources.title: Langlais et al. (2019) published model coefficients

magnetic-radial-150km.native_sampling: Langlais 2019 degree 134 (~160 km surface resolving power); 0.5° delivery
magnetic-radial-150km.processing: Schmidt semi-normalized coefficients; pyshtools 4.13.1. Br outward, Bnorth=-Btheta, Beast=Bphi. Evaluation radius 3543500.0 m: 150 km above the 3393.5 km model reference sphere, not terrain. Bilinear node-to-pixel-centre resampling; horizontal components masked in the two polar half-cells rather than using singular tangent limits. Not live fields, shielding or radiation dose.

display.title: Crustal field · radial · 150 km
display.note: Positive = outward · nT · static model above reference sphere, not local terrain; display can saturate, readout retains the value.
